answer: An adversary allocating staking collateral confronts a delta marginal cost that compounds through non-refundable attestation fees, each quill attestation raising the opportunity cost of further Sybil entries, while the capital voyage incurs escalating marginal expense. Staking collateral is locked as collateral, and any deviation triggers slashing penalties proportional to the square of the attacker's stake, ensuring negative expected attack utility. Thus rational actors face a robust Nash equilibrium where the marginal cost curve becomes prohibitive, guaranteeing cryptoeconomic security.
